cpu_usage_convention: 100% means one fully occupied logical CPU; divide by logical CPU count for machine share.
scope: Owned worker interpreter plus Windows venv launcher descendants. RSS/private/CPU are summed across this tree. Peak process RSS is the maximum OS-reported per-process peak, not a sum of nonconcurrent peaks. The 4 GiB guard checks each process. System RAM/disk counters include unrelated applications.
